method: Independent GDAL PDS reader and label georeferencing, PROJ coordinate transformation, bilinear heights and Cartesian local-frame ray angles; no production helpers imported. Denser radial samples to 150 km.
frame: Mean Earth / Polar Axis, planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude
verticalDatum: Height above the 1,737,400 m sphere; PDS scale/offset applied as radius then reference radius subtracted. Identical app observer elevation and 2 m mast used for both skyline calculations.
limitations: Independent implementation of the same NASA 20 m PDS source, not an independent mission dataset or direct QuickMap skyline certification. The app may include regional 5 m data absent from this reference. The 0.1 degree threshold is a review trigger, not an error guarantee.
